description: OpenAI-compatible language model provider for the Run editor chat panel.
config.apiBase: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API (for example https://api.openai.com/v1 or a local llama.cpp/ollama OpenAI endpoint).
config.model: Default model id sent to the API.
config.models: Model ids shown in the chat model picker.
config.apiKey: API key for the chat endpoint. Prefer the Set API Key command, which stores the key in secret storage. An environment variable RUN_CHAT_API_KEY also works.
